description: Contact quotes two numbers that contacted a relative (not expected, even though one asked for card details), then gives their own callback number tied to a transfer.

messages.text: hey sorry to bother u, someone called my cousin from +44 7700 900412 claiming to be from your delivery team, asked her for her card number. is that you guys??
Thanks for flagging this. We never ask for card numbers by phone.
ok good. she said they also texted from 07700 900587 but she blocked it
anyway for my own refund pls call me back on 07700 900233, I need to confirm the transfer details before tomorrow
